 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.251/2023 dated 26.02.2023 registered at Police Station Arakshi Kendra Adhartal, District Jabalpur for the offence under Sections 363, 366,
342 and 376(2)(cha) and 376(3) of IPC and Sections 3/4 and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
He further submits that prosecutrix and applicant are cousin.
He also submits that prosecutrix is a consenting party.

Investigation is complete and charge-sheet Abhishek Alias Abhi Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133444364/

sentences.text: has been filed.
The applicant is in custody since 05.03.2023 (as mentioned in the application) and trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that applicant is permanent resident of district and there is no likelihood of his absconding from the clutches of law or tamper with prosecution evidence.
He also submits that the applicant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the directions and conditions which may be imposed by this Hon'ble Court.
Upon these grounds, the applicant may be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Applicant has prayed for bail on the ground that prosecutrix has admitted that she was in consensual love relationship with the applicant but the birth certificate of prosecutrix seized during investigation reveals that she was born on 23.10.2008 and on the date of incident she had not completed even 15 years of age.
Looking to aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is not inclined to allow the bail application of the applicant, therefore, his application is hereby rejected.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE Nitesh Abhishek Alias Abhi Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133444364/
